📢 Call of the Hezbollah Brigades: Iraqi nation, shatter the siege on Iran

◀️ The Iraqi Hezbollah Brigades issued a strongly worded statement today, Thursday, fiercely condemning the cooperation of some of the country's airlines with US sanctions against Iran.

◀️ Iraqi Hezbollah described America's oppressive siege on the Iranian nation as "a historical continuation of the suffering of Muslims in the valley of Abu Talib," and said that Washington seeks through such actions to break the will of the Iranian people to resist.

◀️ After America failed to break the will of the Iranian nation through military war, it has resorted to a filthier weapon — to tear apart the bodies of the innocent and, through its savagery, to achieve what it could not with its war arsenals.

◀️ According to the statement, the disposition of Zionist American politicians in keeping nations hungry is a human downfall that once again proves the flashy slogans of the arrogant powers are nothing but lies.

◀️ Hezbollah, noting that America has been skilled since the genocide of the Red Indian tribes at turning people's daily bread into a criminal tool for dominating their fate, stressed: The cries of Iraqi children in the nineties under the brutal siege are not so distant. Today this targeted Zionist-American crime has been repeated, targeting the nations of Palestine, Yemen, and Iran.

◀️ This resistance group, while fiercely criticizing "the shameful hypocrisy of politicians who recline on the throne of fear and don the robe of submission," noted: It is as though keeping nations hungry, destroying them, and killing children is a justified act. Institutions and companies that have submitted to America's unjust decisions in exchange for meager gains are obedient backers of American-Zionist decisions.

◀️ The Hezbollah Brigades, stating that such companies took part in tightening the siege on a believing nation, recalled Iran's support for Iraq during the time of ISIS and called on the Iraqi nation to shatter this siege.

◀️ In conclusion, the group posed this question to the esteemed sources of emulation: What is the religious ruling on aiding the enemies in the siege of the believing nation of Iran?

▶️ Seyyed Mohammad Khatami, former president of Iran, in a message addressed to Masoud Pezeshkian, expressed appreciation for his speech at the UN General Assembly.

▶️ Khatami described Pezeshkian's remarks as "unpretentious, measured, logical, and dignified" and said the president's emphasis on the civilizational heritage and peace-seeking character of Iranians, as well as the resistance and resilience of the Iranian people, was a commendable step.

▶️ He also described Pezeshkian's trip to New York as an opportunity to strengthen empathy among the people, the government, and the establishment, and expressed hope that this opportunity would be used to pursue national interests and ease the people's concerns.

▶️ In conclusion, Khatami called for finding the "least costly and most effective path" to overcome the current crisis and stressed the need to uphold the rights of the nation and national expediency, and to work toward lifting the shadow of war from Iran.
